insitu.warning.spt_refusal: {count} SPT record(s) at refusal; N is a lower bound at depth(s) {depths} m.
insitu.warning.spt_cn_out_of_range: σ′v0 > 200 kPa: the Liao & Whitman C_N is outside its recommended range.
insitu.warning.cpt_no_u2: No u2 data: q_t is taken equal to q_c.
insitu.warning.cpt_points_skipped: {count} CPT point(s) with q_t ≤ σv0, σ′v0 ≤ 0 or f_s ≤ 0 were skipped (I_c undefined).
insitu.warning.cpt_gamma_nearest: Unit weight could not be estimated at {count} CPT point(s) (q_t ≤ 0, depths {depths} m); the nearest estimated value was used for the stresses.
insitu.warning.cpt_gamma_floor: The Robertson & Cabal (2010) unit weight fell below {gamma_min} kN/m³ at {count} CPT point(s); the lower bound {gamma_min} kN/m³ (project assumption) was used.
layering.warning.gamma_floor: Layer {top}-{bottom} m: the CPT unit weight estimate fell below the {gamma_min} kN/m³ lower bound (project assumption) at some points; the bound was used.
correlation.warning.gamma_floor: The estimate is below {gamma_min} kN/m³; the lower bound (project assumption) was used.
insitu.warning.cpt_predrill_excluded: {count} CPT reading(s) shallower than the predrill depth {predrill} m were excluded from processing.
insitu.warning.cpt_not_converged: The Q_tn iteration did not converge at {count} point(s).
layering.warning.no_data_interval: No data between {top} m and {bottom} m; the interval is extrapolated from the nearest samples.
layering.warning.thin_merged: A layer thinner than the minimum thickness was merged with a neighbour.
layering.warning.drainage_ic_based: Drainage behaviour is derived only from Ic < 2.6 (Robertson 2009) and must be confirmed for the loading case; zone 1 is assumed undrained.
layering.warning.processing_warnings: Processing of the investigation data produced warnings; review the processed data.
layering.warning.invalid_ic: Some samples have no valid Ic and were not used for classification.
layering.warning.thin_retained: Layer {top}-{bottom} m is thinner than the minimum thickness but was retained (SBTn zone {raw_zone}).
layering.warning.behaviour_assumed: Drained/undrained behaviour is assumed and must be confirmed by the engineer.
layering.warning.drainage_transitional: Layer {top}-{bottom} m has mixed drained and undrained samples; behaviour is transitional.
layering.warning.gamma_unavailable: Unit weight could not be estimated for some layers; enter it manually.
layering.warning.lens_smoothed: Thin lenses within layer {top}-{bottom} m were smoothed into the surrounding layer.
layering.warning.refusal_in_layer: SPT refusal recorded in layer {top}-{bottom} m; the layer mean N60 excludes refusal depths.
layering.warning.n_missing_or_zero: N is missing or zero for some tests; the layer N60 may be unrepresentative.
layering.warning.log_gap: The borehole log has a gap; the adjacent layer was extended over it.
layering.warning.log_degenerate_interval: Borehole log interval {top}-{bottom} m has no thickness after adjustment and was skipped.
layering.warning.log_no_test: A log interval contains no SPT test.
layering.warning.uscs_missing: USCS symbol is missing for some layers.
layering.warning.tests_outside_log: Some SPT tests lie outside the borehole log intervals.
layering.warning.uscs_mixed: Samples with different USCS symbols were grouped into one layer.
layering.warning.uscs_qualified: USCS classification from laboratory data is incomplete or qualified.
layering.warning.log_missing: The borehole has no log; layering used laboratory USCS and N values instead.
layering.warning.similar_merged: Adjacent layers of the same soil behaviour were merged.
parameters.warning.phi_cv_assumed_equal_: phi'cv is not modelled; phi' = {phi_eff} deg is used in its place, which is unconservative for a peak value.
parameters.warning.value_not_computable: Value is not computable for method {method_id} with these inputs.

error.detail.slope_undrained_unsupported: Layer {top}–{bottom} m: sloping backfill is not supported for undrained (total stress) soil.
